title: The Harlem Globetrotters
seo_title: Harlem Globetrotters Rivalry Tour in Springfield, MO
description: The Harlem Globetrotters bring their Rivalry Tour to the court as they face the Washington Generals and a new lineup of rivals, with fans sometimes pulled onto the court to join the squad. It is for all ages, and a free pre-game tip-off party starts when doors open at 6:00 PM. It takes place Tuesday, March 16, 2027 at 7:00 PM at Great Southern Bank Arena, 901 S. National Ave., Springfield, MO; parking is $20, or $50 for premium parking.
